Our story

Social trust grows one relationship at a time.

Weaving is the everyday work of building relationships across differences. We share stories, connect local leaders, and help communities put social trust into practice.

  • Recognize

    Weaving starts with noticing the people, places, and everyday moments that help a community feel connected.

  • Resource

    Weave helps local leaders build relationships across differences and connect with others doing the same work.

  • Activate

    Small acts of connection can grow into shared projects, stronger relationships, and lasting community trust.

Impact

A movement built through everyday connection.

Weave supports local leaders and partners as they strengthen relationships, belonging, and social trust in communities.

Get involved

How Will You Strengthen Social Trust?

Whether you are a local leader, potential partner, or simply curious, there is a meaningful way to begin.

Build relationships.

Start with a simple conversation, a shared interest, or a local gathering. Meaningful relationships often begin with one small invitation.

  • Join a local circleFind a welcoming way to connect with people in your community→
  • Come to an open eveningTake part in a gathering designed to make conversation easier→
  • Get a conversation cardUse conversation prompts to help people share stories and listen deeply→

Learn from the field.

Explore practical tools, stories, and learning that help community leaders strengthen relationships and build social trust.

  • Read a field storyLearn from community leaders and their experiences→
  • Download a toolkitFind practical resources to support local connection→
  • See how Weave worksUnderstand the principles behind weaving and belonging→

Turn connection into action.

Bring people together where you live, help a local effort grow, or partner with Weave to strengthen community connection.

  • Apply to host a circleExplore ways to host and support meaningful conversations→
  • Partner with usConnect as a community, nonprofit, or institutional partner→
  • Give to the networkHelp resource leaders and initiatives that build social trust→

Questions

Questions about weaving?

Learn more about weaving and how Weave connects people working to strengthen belonging and social trust.

What does “weaving” mean? +

Weaving is the work of building relationships, belonging, and social trust in everyday life and across communities.

Who is Weave for? +

Weave connects local leaders, community members, funders, and institutional partners who want to strengthen the social fabric.

How can I get involved? +

Explore stories and resources, connect with community initiatives, subscribe for updates, or contact Weave about partnership opportunities.

How can my organization partner with Weave? +

Organizations can connect with Weave to explore collaboration, learning, and opportunities to strengthen relationships and social trust.

Weave strengthens relationships, belonging, and social trust by supporting local leaders and helping communities connect, learn, and take action together.
